Not sure this is great advice, ducks do not do well in an enclosed space in my experience. They "drill" the shit out of the ground and turn the entire area they are in into a grass free mud pit. They aren't bad if you let them free range over a good distance though. As for them laying more eggs, again that has not been our experience and the eggs tend to not taste as good as chicken eggs (though they are better for baking).

Overall we switched to Muscovy ducks, they don't lay nearly as many eggs but essentially take care of themselves. They raise their own young pretty well, require no shelter, and have a flavor very similar to beef. For the last few years, our Muscovy population has increased and the only maintenance we do is toss them a trivial amount of food every morning to keep them loyal.
